notes.title: V3.0 IS HERE!!! - CUSTOM CHARACTERS!
notes.notes: Yes! You can now add Obama to Let's Kill This Guy with Hammers!!! It's simple. Click on Open Mods folder, title your 500x500 png image to "obamaChar.png", and then boom. Obama.
